options.rationale: Correct: MPI integrity requires verifying and reconciling potential duplicates.
Deletion before verification risks losing valid information.
Unverified merges can combine different patients.

options.text: Ignore it unless a clinician complains
options.rationale: Unresolved duplicates threaten patient safety and data integrity.
